entries.justification: Route /certificates, fixture variant empty, theme dark, rule color-contrast. This entry was REVEALED, not created, by Phase 216's certificates fixture enrichment (216-02, D-05/D-07): the /certificates fixture previously shipped with no certificate records, so this route's badges never rendered under any prior a11y sweep and the baseline sat empty. The underlying colour debt pre-dates this phase; only the harness's ability to see it is new. Matches the default-dark entry's own two samples exactly (`--qs-node-safe`+white "Safe" badge, and a bare `--status-critical` text label) because the enriched fixture's summary cards render before the per-record empty-state branch does. The `--qs-node-safe`+white badge pairs a `bg-[hsl(var(--risk-badge-high))]` or `bg-[hsl(var(--qs-node-safe))]` badge background with white foreground text — exactly the zero-design-input swap FIX-01 (Phase 217, REQUIREMENTS.md) drains by moving each to its existing `-foreground` sibling token (`--risk-badge-high-foreground` / `--qs-node-safe-foreground`), which needs no new token and no visual redesign. The bare `--status-critical` text label does not match any of FIX-01's named `-foreground` swaps, FIX-02/FIX-03's `text-black` badge sites, or FIX-04's five named design-call tokens (`--destructive`, `--quantum-safe`, `--badge-modbus`). It is nonetheless dashboard contrast debt this milestone tracks, and is swept up by FIX-05 (Phase 218), which requires zero badge/contrast pair anywhere in the dashboard below 4.5:1 in either theme, verified by RATCHET-01 reporting an empty baseline. Per 216-CONTEXT.md D-04/D-09, this phase BASELINES this finding rather than fixing it: a phase whose job is instrument repair (fixing the harness's fixture and theme coverage) must not also change product pixels, or a red gate becomes unattributable to either change on its own.
